summary: Iteration 4 (Multi-Cabang) frontend testing complete. 13 of 13 requested scenarios verified. Branch selector, per-branch data filtering (dashboard KPIs, Repairs 8/5/3, Customers 3/2, Spareparts 5/3), Reports branch-breakdown visibility, Branches CRUD page, locked selector for teknisi (br1)=5 repairs and teknisi2 (br2)=3 repairs, and RepairNew customer scoping (br1=3 customers) all work as expected. Two issues found: (1) BranchSelector dropdown does NOT refresh after creating a new branch (requires page reload); the Branches page card list does update immediately. (2) Non-blocking React hydration warning in RepairNew.jsx due to <span> nested inside <option>.

ui_bugs.issue: Newly created branch is not reflected in the topbar branch-selector dropdown until page reload. BranchContext branches list is not re-fetched after branchesApi.create(). Cards on /branches page update correctly, only the selector is stale.

React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. The customer <select> renders options via a component that wraps text in a span, causing console error. Use plain text child of <option>.

action_items: In BranchContext (or Branches.jsx after create/update/delete), trigger a re-read of branchesApi.list() so BranchSelector immediately shows the new branch without a page reload.
Fix RepairNew.jsx <option> children to be plain strings (avoid wrapping in <span>) to eliminate hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: BranchContext should expose a refresh() (or subscribe to a branches mutation event) so any component mutating branches keeps the selector in sync.
RepairNew.jsx: `<option>{`${c.name} — ${c.phone}`}</option>` — ensure the child is a raw template literal, not a component that inserts a span wrapper.
seed_data_creation: Created 'Cabang Test' branch (code TST) during testing on /branches page. Since data lives in localStorage of the ephemeral browser session, no persistent cleanup needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-4 multi-branch behaviors verified via Playwright: dropdown options (branch-option-all/br1/br2), KPI changes per branch, repairs 8/5/3, customers 3/2, spareparts 5/3, reports branch-breakdown only-when-all, branches page CRUD (create OK, delete br2 blocked because it has repairs), locked selector for technicians, RepairNew scopes customers to selected branch. Only outstanding UI polish items are BranchContext refresh on create and RepairNew option/span hydration warning.
rca_of_the_issue: BranchSelector reads the branches list from BranchContext which is initialized once (likely via useState(() => branchesApi.list()) or similar) and never re-reads after mutations happen elsewhere. The Branches.jsx page maintains its own local state via a re-fetch, hence the discrepancy.
